_about: GENERATED by tools/build_rules.js -- do not edit. Edit rules/policy.json or the source files, then rerun.
engine_version: v2.3-20261008 (88 layouts; +2 map layouts in deck-maps.js; text fit)

canvas._units: Geometry is engine inches and sizes engine pt. Scale by (deck slide width in inches / 13.33): 2.0005 for a template-made deck, 1 for a builder-made deck.

policy._about: HAND-EDITED. Design Pass policy: what each check does and its tolerances. Calibrate these numbers against designer-reviewed decks (pilot step 1). Everything else in rules/ is generated -- see rules/README.md.
policy._mode: The checker page reports first, then offers 'Apply fixes' for checks whose action is 'fix' (the user can untick categories). Decks flagged for a rebuild get no fixes.

font_face.brief: Fonts -> Mazda Type Bold / Mazda Type / Arial by role

type_scale.brief: Sizes on the type scale (fix once calibrated)

colour.brief: Off-palette colour -> nearest palette token, only when unambiguous

theme_colours.brief: Theme colour scheme differs from the template's

background.brief: Slide background -> the layout's template background, only when the layout allows one

logo_variant.brief: Light/dark logo or lockup on the wrong background

casing.brief: Caps where the template sets caps

position.brief: Snap text boxes to template positions, conservative tolerance

density.brief: Content that wants splitting: propose the split

off_template.brief: Slide not on an MMW layout: rebuild candidate

chart_image.brief: Chart as a picture: rebuild natively, verify numbers

wording.brief: Wording and data are never changed

flag_faces.Mazda Type Medium: Mazda brand face the MMW template does not use: designer to choose Mazda Type Bold (display) or Arial (body).

fonts._flag_faces: Fonts that are never auto-mapped: flagged for a designer with this note.
fonts._display_min_pt: Engine pt. Off-template text at or above this size is treated as display (open question 8: refine with placeholder type and position).

type_scale._tolerance_pt: Engine pt. A run is on the scale when within this of any size the template uses for its face.

colour._rule: <= exact_de of a palette or template colour: on palette. Else snap only if the nearest palette token is <= snap_max_de AND the runner-up is >= ambiguity_margin_de further or at least twice as far; otherwise flag. #000000 is in 'ignore' for reporting because PowerPoint writes it for default text; it is still reported when used as a fill.

position._units: Engine inches (13.33 x 7.5 canvas). Within snap_in: fix. Between snap_in and flag_in: flag (the template's own demo slides sit up to 0.18 in off their layouts). Past flag_in: ignored as deliberate.

placeholder_text._note: Case-insensitive substring match. 'tbd' and 'xx%' are flagged, never removed -- they may be the author's own markers.

density._rule: Field text > copy budget max x over_budget_ratio: copy_fit flag. > split_ratio, or more than max_words / max_bullets on a slide: density flag with a split proposal.

template_reference._note: Template slides that are instructions or resource sheets (how-to, font install, brand assets, icon sheets), not layout examples. Left out of rules/template_snapshot.json.

template_detect._note: A master is an MMW master when it carries at least this many MMW layout names (a template-derived master carries all 66), or any MMW layout name plus the template's heading font (Mazda Type Bold) in its theme. Judged per master: 'Title & Bullets' is also a Keynote default, and decks mix masters.

rollup._note: Deck-wide patterns become one deck-level decision. Off-template on at least this share of slides: one deck finding, per-slide rebuild notes dropped. An off-palette colour on at least max(palette_min_slides, palette_min_share x slides) slides: listed once as the deck's own palette, per-slide flags dropped.

annotation._note: Template notes to the deck author, never content: text in these colours, and text-free lines/shapes drawn in them (the 'click here' arrows on the social dividers are #EC0076). Removed by the annotation fix.
